page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.6xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance within the ecs.r6 family, built on x86_64 architecture under the KVM hypervisor. The system is equipped with dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors operating at 2.5 GHz, providing 24 dedicated vCPUs alongside 192.0 GB of RAM. This configuration maintains a high memory-to-vCPU allocation of 8.0 GB per core, targeting memory-bound enterprise applications.

Networking performance for the instance includes an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The ecs.r6.6xlarge does not include bundled local disk storage or dedicated GPU hardware, requiring persistent storage workloads to rely on network-attached storage solutions.

With its 8.0 GB RAM per vCPU ratio, the instance offers strong resource density for workloads requiring high memory capacity relative to compute cores. This profile provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy operational models without over-provisioning processing units. Best-fit use cases include in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning deployments, large-scale caching, and memory-intensive analytics.
